annotation.title_clean: Official Journal of the European Communities C 197/74 – European Parliament sitting of 24 October 2000 (heavy metals protocol; medical devices incorporating human blood derivatives)
annotation.title_en: Official Journal of the European Communities C 197/74 – European Parliament sitting of 24 October 2000 (heavy metals protocol; medical devices incorporating human blood derivatives)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities
annotation.summary_en: Excerpt from the Official Journal recording European Parliament proceedings of 24 October 2000: approval of a Council decision on the heavy metals protocol and a second-reading legislative resolution approving the common position amending Directive 93/42/EEC on medical devices containing human blood derivatives. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament approved the Council decision concluding the 1998 Protocol on heavy metals.
Parliament approved the Council common position amending Directive 93/42/EEC on medical devices with human blood derivatives.
Act deemed adopted per common position under Article 251(2) EC.
